title: Transforms: Where Is the Gripper, in Which Frame, and How Do You Know

questions.question: What does a transform describe?
options: Where one frame sits relative to another: a rotation and a translation
How fast a joint is moving
The shape of a robot link
A position in the world frame only
questions.explanation: Turn by the rotation, then move by the translation. Chaining them is how a camera reading becomes something an arm can act on.

questions.question: How does transforming a direction differ from transforming a point?
options: A direction is only rotated, because moving a frame does not change which way north is
A direction is only translated
There is no difference
A direction must be normalised first
questions.explanation: Using the wrong one gives an answer wrong by exactly the translation: small, plausible, persistent, and able to survive review for months.

questions.question: What does the naming rule T_world_base times T_base_gripper let you check?
options: That the adjacent names match and cancel, which turns a geometry question into a spelling check
That the rotations are unit quaternions
That the translations are in metres
That the transforms were measured at the same time
questions.explanation: If the inner names disagree the composition is wrong, and you can see it by reading rather than by reasoning about geometry.

questions.question: Why is the inverse translation not simply the negation?
options: The original is expressed in the original frame, and the inverse needs it in the rotated one
Because negation loses precision
Because the translation might be zero
Because quaternions cannot be negated
questions.explanation: It has to be rotated by the undone rotation. The negation only version is exactly right when the rotation is the identity, which is why it survives a suite that never rotates.

questions.question: When composing, why is the inner translation rotated before being added?
options: It is expressed in the inner frame and has to be brought into the outer one first
To keep the result a unit vector
Because addition is not commutative
To avoid overflow
questions.explanation: A quarter turn followed by two metres along the inner x axis is two metres along the outer y axis. Adding before rotating puts it in the wrong place.

questions.question: What does a transform tree such as tf2 add beyond composition?
options: Timestamps, so where the gripper was and where it is are different questions
Automatic unit conversion
Faster matrix multiplication
Guaranteed unit quaternions
questions.explanation: During motion those two questions have different answers, and a tree that ignores time silently answers the wrong one.
